svg.title: About Me
svg.desc: I am a Computer Engineering student and Software Developer driven by a deep curiosity for System Architectures. In every structure I encounter, I strive to go deeper by asking the "why" and "how" behind the technology. My journey has taught me that successful engineering is more than just writing code; it's about managing real-world use cases and maintaining effective communication at the heart of every solution. My primary focus is the Java and Spring Boot ecosystem, where I enjoy building scalable and optimized systems. I am highly passionate about Software Architecture and DevOps principles, aiming to create sustainable value for products and teams by implementing modern best practices and robust cloud infrastructures.
